Home / Book / Before you book

Let's make sure this is the right fit

You chose the Ready for Discharge. That may be exactly what you need, and you are welcome to book it below. Before you do, most people start with a short phone call. Here is why.

Deciding how to keep someone safe at home can feel like a lot, especially when a hospital stay, a fall, or a worried phone call is what brought you here. You do not have to sort it out alone, and you do not have to guess which service is right.

In a 30-minute call, Dr. Russ L'HommeDieu listens to what is going on, asks about the person, the home, and the people who help, and tells you honestly what he recommends. Sometimes that is the visit you chose. Sometimes a different visit fits better, or there is something simpler you can do yourself this week.

Your $50 is not an extra cost. If you book any visit within 30 days, the full $50 comes off that visit.

What the call gives you

  • A clear recommendation for your situation
  • Straight answers about timing, cost, and whether a video or in-home visit makes more sense
  • A plan for what to do first, even if you decide not to book a visit
  • No pressure. Nothing happens without your say.

Is discharge in the next few days? Time matters. You can book the visit directly below, or call (813) 867-3372 and we will fit your consultation in quickly.
